title: Fleet vulnerability coverage correlation pack
notes: This pack keeps OpenVAS-first findings prominent on the operator surfaces.
It focuses on public and pilot services where fresh critical findings should page the operator faster than raw report browsing.
Coverage freshness and unmapped-target drift remain documented as follow-up batch analytics.
OpenVAS remains authoritative. Nmap-derived exposure events are kept supplemental and should not outrank Greenbone findings in operator workflows.

stream_rules.title: Critical Exposure On Fleet Service
stream_rules.operator_action: Pivot into the vulnerability queue for the affected service, confirm scan freshness, and start remediation planning for externally reachable or business-critical nodes.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Critical Exposure On Fleet Service
id: sigma-critical-exposure-on-fleet-service
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: vulnerability
  service: fleet_scanner
detection:
  selection_category:
    event.category: vulnerability
  selection_severity:
    severity:
      - high
      - critical
  selection_target:
    destination.ip:
      - 192.168.1.29
      - 192.168.1.34
      - 192.168.1.36
      - 192.168.1.39
      - 192.168.1.120
      - 192.168.1.121
      - 192.168.1.126
      - 192.168.1.232
  condition: selection_category and selection_severity and selection_target
level: high
tags:
  - vulnerability
  - openvas-primary
  - fleet-service
